description: This file implements the DolbyOutputImplementation class, which provides an implementation of the Exchange::Dolby::IOutput interface for Dolby audio output management, including registration, unregistration of observers, and stubs for querying capabilities.

classes.name: DolbyOutputImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IOutput interface for Dolby audio output, managing observer registration and providing capability query stubs.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification observer for Dolby output events, ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification observer, releasing references and removing from the observer list.

methods.name: AtmosMetadata
methods.description: Stub to indicate Atmos metadata support, currently always returns 'unavailable'.

methods.name: SoundMode
methods.description: Stub to query current sound mode, currently always returns 'unavailable'.

methods.name: EnableAtmosOutput
methods.description: Stub to enable/disable Atmos output, currently always returns 'unavailable'.

methods.name: Mode
methods.description: Gets the current audio output mode.
